label: Bible Study
prompt: Beloved, _____ not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verse: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
note: John's simple test — imitate the good, not the evil.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his _____:
verse: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
note: Forget not all his benefits — the next verses list them: forgiveness, healing, redemption, mercy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride _____ for her husband.
verse: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
note: The new Jerusalem comes down from heaven 'as a bride adorned for her husband' — heaven's grand entrance.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's _____ are the men of his own house.
verse: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
note: Micah describes a society in collapse; Jesus quotes it in Matthew 10:36.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that hath pity upon the poor _____ unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verse: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
note: Give to the poor and you're making a loan to the LORD — and Proverbs promises he will pay it back.
